name: Quant Researcher
description: Statistical depth first. Expect probability, inference, time series and honest evaluation of signals — plus a whiteboard derivation or two.

name: Quant Trader
description: Speed, expected value and market intuition. Mental math, probability puzzles, microstructure and risk under pressure.

name: Quant Developer
description: Engineering rigour applied to numerical finance: data structures, complexity, numerics, backtest infrastructure and correctness.

name: Statistical Arbitrage
description: Cross-sectional and relative-value equity strategies: cointegration, mean reversion, factor neutrality, costs and capacity.

name: Market Making
description: Quoting, inventory risk, adverse selection, queue dynamics and the Avellaneda–Stoikov school of thought.

name: Systematic Macro
description: Cross-asset trend, carry and value; rates and FX mechanics; regime awareness and drawdown management at low breadth.

name: Equity Long/Short Quant
description: Fundamental-meets-systematic: factor exposure, alpha capture, hedging, alternative data and portfolio construction under constraints.

name: Derivatives & Volatility
description: Pricing, hedging and the volatility surface: Itô calculus, Black–Scholes and its failures, Greeks, and vol as an asset class.
